basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed AI Engineer | Fintech & Regulated Products | 3x Founder | MBA
basics.summary: Forward deployed AI engineer and founder. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps, shipping production multi-agent systems on GCP that 2x conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue. Also founder of Anand Creations, my independent practice, and co-founder of SwissNRI, an AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families (regulated, RAG-grounded, guardrails-first). 13+ years building for 10M+ users, including a $1.5M+ revenue product at Beekeeper. MBA-trained, Zurich-based, comfortable sitting with an investor, a compliance officer, or an engineer and shipping the thing that moves the metric.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped production multi-agent workflows for outbound (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK on GCP Vertex AI, tools over MCP, UI streamed over AG-UI). 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory. Event-driven ingest, freshness detection, RAG grounded to source. Same pattern that would let a NewVest agent read 50 GPs' quarterly letters and flag drift.
Own end-to-end: architecture, eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request telemetry, on-call. Report directly to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end to end as tech lead of the Incubation team, reporting to CIO. Ran market research, product scope, and GTM with Sales and PM. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR. Founder work inside a company.
Replaced a $337K annual vendor contract with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated. Zero-to-production is a habit, not a stretch.
Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io) for high-traffic production. Diagnosed and triaged incidents across service, DB, and infra layers.
Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales. Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions. Same diligence lens I would apply to internal ops build-vs-buy calls.
Mentored Opt Alpha (high-frequency algorithmic trading) and advised portfolio companies on AI strategy and hiring.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off. Shipped the full autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries.
Built cloud infra and CI/CD on AWS from scratch. Enterprise reliability that enabled a Unilever partnership and a CES showcase.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed AI Practice
projects.description: Independent forward deployed practice. Open to embedded engagements: sit with a small team, run technical discovery, prototype in weeks, ship to production. Same playbook whether the client is a fintech, a fund, or a SaaS.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability built into the eval loop. If the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship.
